step1.title: Create a habit
step1.body: A habit is a behavior protocol. Tap + to create one: manually or from the template library. You can build a good habit or quit a bad one (avoid).

step2.title: View modes
step2.body: "Today" — the daily matrix. "Week" — a 7-day strip. "All time" — a progress heatmap.

step3.title: Habit card
step3.body: Tap the card to mark it done. Swipe right to pin, left to delete. The streak is shown on the right.

step4.title: Routines
step4.body: Morning and evening routines group habits into sequences. Create them with the buttons below.

step5.title: Habit stacks
step5.body: Beyond morning/evening there are "stacks" — named routines tied to a trigger (anchor cue). Create a new stack with this button.

step6.title: Statistics
step6.body: Streak, today's completion, freezes and total done. Freezes (rest days) don't break your streak — rest without losing it.

step7.title: Analytics
step7.body: A heatmap over 16 weeks or a year. Insights: 7/30-day rate, record, best and worst weekday.

step8.title: Journal
step8.body: Add a note and an emoji to any check-in. The journal below is the history of your reflections.

step9.title: Overview
step9.body: The overview screen: weekly and monthly completion rate, an aggregate heatmap, leaders and lagging habits.

complete.title: COURSE COMPLETE
complete.body: You've mastered the Habit Matrix. Discipline is your foundation, operative.
